title: The Pale House
author: Theo Joubert
blurb: Bram Hartwell, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
